mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 over the previous month signals strong economic growth, boosting investor confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 300,000.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where GDPC1 declines over two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals increased economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) increases by more than 0.5% over the previous 3 months, it signals a tightening monetary policy with a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with labor market weakness
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where FEDFUNDS > 2% and UNRATE increases by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% year-over-year signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where HOUST decreases by more than 10% year-over-year.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.5% over the previous 3 months and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000, it signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5% and PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% within a month signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS decreases by more than 0.25%.
